action_args.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but low predictability with ambiguous stationarity. The leader (mean over the 7 most stable models) is a robust, simple combination that avoids overfitting to three noisy validation windows. The runner-up margin of 0.006 is indistinguishable from noise, confirming that no alternative strategy offers a statistically meaningful gain.
